context: Replaces three unwrap() calls on a payment gateway response with proper error propagation.
explanation: The old code unwrapped a fallible network call and two header lookups on a live payment path - a gateway timeout, a declined charge, or a missing/malformed receipt header would all panic and crash the request. The rewrite propagates the gateway error with `?` and turns the two header-lookup failure modes into explicit PaymentError variants, so callers can retry or surface a real error to the customer instead of a 500 from a panic.
